characteristic_sites: nasal cavity / sinuses / palate ('lethal midline granuloma')

biomarkers.name: EBV (EBER ISH)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark. Plasma EBV DNA quantitation used for monitoring (higher = more disease). Post-treatment EBV DNA is prognostic

biomarkers.name: NK-cell / cytotoxic T-cell immunophenotype (CD2+, CD3ε cytoplasmic+, CD56+, CD5-, cytotoxic markers+)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinguishes NK from T lineage; determines TCR clonality testing utility

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Checkpoint inhibitors such as pembrolizumab and nivolumab have demonstrated activity in relapsed/refractory ENKTL, but PD-L1 IHC is not a validated or required companion predictive biomarker and reported response rates vary across small series

biomarkers.name: Asparaginase (L-asparaginase) response
biomarkers.clinical_use: ENKTL is characteristically sensitive to asparaginase-containing regimens (e.g., SMILE, DDGP-based approaches). Foundation of therapy

biomarkers.name: PINK / PINK-E prognostic scores
biomarkers.clinical_use: Prognostic Index of Natural Killer lymphoma (PINK): age >60 years, stage III/IV disease, non-nasal type, distant lymph-node involvement. PINK-E adds detectable EBV DNA

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Angiocentric, angiodestructive infiltrate of atypical NK or T cells with prominent vascular invasion and coagulative necrosis; pleomorphic cytology
variants: extra-nasal ENKTL (skin, testis, GI, soft tissue — worse prognosis)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: EBV-driven (near-universal); high PD-L1 expression is common and checkpoint inhibitors such as pembrolizumab and nivolumab have shown activity in relapsed/refractory disease, although no fixed response rate or PD-L1 IHC cutoff is established clinically. Asparaginase is uniquely effective
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Angiocentric growth with vascular invasion; extensive coagulative necrosis due to vascular occlusion; historically called 'lethal midline granuloma'

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: NK cells (majority) or cytotoxic T cells with EBV infection driving lineage biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (NK cells or cytotoxic T cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: NK-cell differentiation (CD2+, cCD3ε+, CD56+, EBER+) or cytotoxic T-cell differentiation (CD8+ variable); cytotoxic granules (TIA-1+, granzyme B+, perforin+)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: EBV latency programme (typically type II) drives biology in most cases; asparaginase uniquely effective, reflecting dependence on extracellular asparagine rather than validated arginine auxotrophy
